presentation.label: SCALE / ROOT
presentation.summary: Keep pitch edits and chromatic trig keys in one of 24 scales with a selectable root.
presentation.overview: Scale Quantizer adds SCALE, ROOT and GLIDE to PROJECT > CONTROL > SEQUENCER. Pitch turns and parameter locks move through scale degrees, and chromatic trig keys snap to the chosen scale. ROOT transposes the scale and keyboard. SCALE OFF restores stock pitch behavior.
highlights: Pitch knob, parameter locks and chromatic keys follow the scale
usage: Open PROJECT > CONTROL > SEQUENCER and set SCALE. OFF preserves stock pitch behavior; choose a scale to constrain notes.
Set ROOT to the key you want. Pitch edits step by scale degree; chromatic keys snap to a degree and key 1 plays the root.
SCALE, ROOT and GLIDE persist through project save/reload and battery RAM. Synth polyphony and synth glide features require SYNTH MACHINE, which is outside this import.

controls.name: SCALE
controls.doc: OFF restores stock pitch behavior; select a scale to constrain PTCH edits, locks and chromatic keys.

controls.name: ROOT
controls.doc: Root of the scale and chromatic keyboard. Ignored with SCALE OFF.

controls.name: GLIDE
controls.doc: OFF or 1–127 slide time; the track LEG setting controls legato. Synth features require the separate SYNTH MACHINE module.

limitations: Sample pitch quantization works on Flex, Static and Pickup; RATE is not a semitone control.
SCALE, ROOT and GLIDE are shared project settings, not independent per-track scale selectors.
Synth polyphony and synth-specific tuning/glide require FM Synth and are outside the standalone Quantizer.
POLY8 configurations use the existing POLY8 keyboard hooks; this update does not change POLY8 or FM Synth runtime code.
Current-version physical hardware, reboot, audio, chip timing and complete memory bounds remain untested.

storage.label: ROM footprint
storage.conditions: Upstream v2.9 record: 192-byte core, 45-byte key stub and 6-byte scale trampoline. DRAM code, grown menus and loader overhead are additional; this is not a new local assembly measurement.

processing.label: CPU load
processing.conditions: No comparable hardware CPU utilization measurement is supplied.

impact.conditions: Audio modules are rated for an active instance, including expensive modes and changing controls; MIDI/USB features are rated while enabled. More tracks or instances increase demand. Shared runtime reservations and reused stock buffers are not added again per module. These rough source-backed tiers do not establish hardware headroom or qualification.

cpu.rationale: Scale Quantizer applies bounded note/pitch and control hooks on ColdFire. It adds no continuous audio-processing engine; low is a source estimate and dense note/control traffic can increase work.

dsp.rationale: The author documentation explicitly declares no DSP code for this module. Minimal rates added quantizer DSP demand; stock voice rendering remains part of the whole device load.

memory.rationale: The upstream record lists a 243-byte ROM core/stub/trampoline footprint plus small settings. DRAM code, menus and loader overhead are additional. Minimal is a relative source estimate, not a claim that total memory is only 243 bytes.

tests.summary: MIDI trig-mode stack corruption reproduced on the old standalone build; the repaired popup passes on MKI/MKII emulated panels. Native/browser comparison: 53 matching module-owned images, 73 matching refusals, zero mismatches. The owner approved this exact experimental source with hardware, chip timing and complete memory bounds untested.

tutorial.title: Quick tutorial: choose a scale
steps: Open PROJECT > CONTROL > SEQUENCER and scroll to SCALE. Turn LEVEL to select MAJOR; OFF restores stock pitch behavior.
Scroll to ROOT and turn LEVEL to choose C. ROOT transposes the selected scale and the audio chromatic keyboard.
Close the project menu, select a Flex or Static audio track with a sample assigned, and turn PTCH or play the chromatic trig keys. Notes follow the selected scale.
Switch to MIDI mode. Hold FUNC and press DOWN or UP to change trig mode; release FUNC to leave the popup. MIDI octave numbers retain the stock format.

access.location: PROJECT > CONTROL > SEQUENCER: SCALE, ROOT and GLIDE rows.
steps: On the MKII panel, press PROJ to open the project menu.
Use UP/DOWN to select CONTROL, then press RIGHT to enter its list.
Select SEQUENCER with UP/DOWN and press YES.
Scroll DOWN to SCALE and turn LEVEL to choose a scale. OFF restores stock pitch behavior.
Scroll to ROOT and turn LEVEL to select the key. GLIDE is the next row; its effect depends on the track’s LEG setting.
